This is by design. We check for confirmed payments here as well, whose inputs will inherently not be in the UTXO set. See [this commit](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35302/changes/6cbb0ea9dc96cf4ab4a225a4d97e2dae70369b05) for the use cases. FWIW, a "real" scanner would use the undo data and block rather than `-txindex` and `getrawtransaction`.

Side note related to thsee calls, either we assume `-txindex` is enabled as is done here, or the user has to pass a block hash they expect the payment to be in, which would be cumbersome for writing tests IMO.
